notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP. Plain requests (no impersonation) got a 403 Access Denied (Akamai edge block) on robots.txt; curl_cffi with impersonate='chrome' returned 200 on robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and every category page fetched thereafter - no block encountered on this site at tier (a), so tiers (b)/(c) were never needed. robots.txt (https://www2.hm.com/robots.txt) explicitly lists ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/anthropic-ai under 'Allow: /' (only Baiduspider/Yeti/Daumoa/PetalBot are disallowed), so tier (c) would also have been permitted, but Claude-in-Chrome was reported disconnected and was not attempted. TREE: fetched https://www2.hm.com/fr_fr/maison.html and pulled every /fr_fr/maison/catalogue-par-produit/* href from the rendered HTML (914 total nav links) to build the candidate node list, then fetched each candidate node directly. Each category page embeds a Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ JSON blob at props.pageProps.plpProps containing heading, breadcrumb.links (used to confirm the requested node's real parent/label - several mega-menu slugs are internal redirect aliases, e.g. textiles/couvertures.html silently serves the Linge-de-lit>Couvertures listing, textiles/nappes-et-chemins-de-table.html, textiles/serviettes-de-table.html, textiles/torchons.html, textiles/tapis-de-bain.html, textiles/rideaux-de-douche.html, textiles/serviettes-de-toilette.html all carry '-int-redirect' or department-mismatched trackingLabels and serve the Cuisine-et-art-de-la-table / Accessoires-Salle-de-Bain listing instead of a distinct Textiles one; deco/coussins.html and mobilier/coussins-de-chaise.html likewise alias to the same Textiles listing) and pills.navigationLinks (the page's own subcategory pill list), which was used to positively confirm completeness of the textiles.html, linge-de-lit.html, rangements.html, enfants-bebe.html and accessoires-salle-bain.html subtrees (no additional child nodes exist beyond what was fetched). Each duplicate/aliased node was recorded once only, filed under its true breadcrumb parent, per duplicate-record rule. QTY: read directly from props.pageProps.plpProps.productListingSectionProps.productListingData.totalHits (exact integer, matches the site's own product-listing total for that node) on every leaf; every leaf's breadcrumb label was checked against the requested node name before recording qty, per the bad-slug caution in the brief. Parent nodes with confirmed subcategories (textiles.html, linge-de-lit.html, rangements.html) were NOT given their own qty/link rows (parent-URL rule); they appear only as grouping rows, grouped instead by each leaf's own true breadcrumb parent (Textiles d'interieur / Linge de lit / Cuisine et art de la table / Accessoires Salle de Bain / Enfants & Bebes / Rangement) since several leaves' real parent differs from the mega-menu link that surfaced them. EXCLUDED: textiles/tout-afficher.html, linge-de-lit/tout-afficher.html, rangements/tout-afficher.html, enfants-bebe/tout-afficher.html, accessoires-salle-bain/tout-afficher.html, maison/catalogue-par-produit/view-all.html (all View All/Shop All); catalogue-par-univers/* room-based cross-cut pages (alternate navigation view over the same underlying product listings already captured via catalogue-par-produit, would double count); mobilier/rangement.html 'Solutions de Rangement' (106 items) - explicitly breadcrumbed under Mobilier/Furniture, excluded per storage.md Sec21/27 (website places it in Furniture, not Storage - belongs to the separate Furniture task); accessoires-salle-bain/accessoires.html 'Accessoires Salle de Bain' (91 items) - generic bathroom-accessories catch-all (soap dispensers, bins, hooks etc.), not primarily textile nor primarily storage, excluded as neither; enfants-bebe/deco.html, jouets.html, mobilier-luminaires.html, salle-a-manger-cuisine.html - decor/toys/furniture-lighting/dining, neither category; maison/catalogue-par-produit/vetements-nuit.html (nightwear) - apparel, excluded per textile.md Sec19; deco/*, luminaires/*, parfums-ambiance/*, plantes/*, cuisine-art-table/{assiettes,carafes-pichets,couverts-table,glassware,livres-de-cuisine,mugs-tasses,plateaux,services-vaisselle}.html - decorative accessories / lighting / fragrance / plants / kitchen & dining tableware, all outside both rule files' boundaries. Tablecloths/table-runners/napkins/tea-towels/placemats were kept as Textile despite the website filing them under its 'Cuisine et art de la table' department, per textile.md Sec7/8's explicit Primary-Product-Type-over-website-hierarchy examples (Tablecloth/Table Runner/Napkin/Tea Towel = Textile). No fabrication; every qty is the site's own totalHits field; every URL was actually fetched and returned 200 with a matching breadcrumb.
